Primary ask: Reduce per-recommendation cost while keeping tail latency tight. Interested in batching/caching/quantization knobs and a reproducible perf harness we can run against their traffic trace.

Perf targets (customer): p50 20-30ms, p95 <=50ms at sustained 200 RPS; must handle bursts to 2k RPS for flash sales. Cost target: hosted token-equivalent cost <= $0.001 per request on average (they price per-recommendation).

Data constraints: EU payment flows must be processed in EU region; procurement wants VPC + strict KMS controls. No full air-gap required but log residency for 12 months. SOC2 required, ISO27001 desired but not mandatory.
